results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller context (msg.sender) triggers the permissionless release and is logged as the indexed `caller` in `ProtocolFeesReleased(msg.sender, treasury, amount)`, while the transfer destination (`protocolTreasury`) and transfer amount (`protocolFees`) are read from contract storage.
results.flow_security_relevance: Zeroes the accumulated `protocolFees` liability and executes an external ERC-20 transfer of `quoteToken` to `protocolTreasury` after screening the recipient against protocol plumbing addresses; security review must verify strict CEI ordering, single-payout idempotency, accounting isolation from `unsettledPot`/`sponsorProceeds`/`winnerProceeds`/`remainingRefundLiability`, and that `protocolTreasury` cannot be a protocol sink.
results.flow_summary: When `protocolFees > 0` after winning ticket settlement (`NftWon` or `CashWon`), any external caller can invoke `releaseProtocolFees()` to zero `protocolFees`, validate `protocolTreasury` against protocol plumbing addresses via `_isProtocolDestination`, transfer the full accumulated `quoteToken` fee balance to `protocolTreasury`, emit `ProtocolFeesReleased`, and return the transferred amount.
results.flow_terminal_action: External ERC-20 token transfer `quoteToken.safeTransfer(protocolTreasury, amount)` followed by `ProtocolFeesReleased(msg.sender, treasury, amount)` event emission and return of `amount`.

packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:386 Raffle.releaseProtocolFees - Reads accumulated `protocolFees` storage variable into `amount`.
packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:387 Raffle.releaseProtocolFees - Validates `amount != 0` (passes when settlement has allocated positive protocol fees that have not yet been claimed).
packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:388 Raffle.releaseProtocolFees - Clears `protocolFees = 0` in storage before external calls.
packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:389-390 Raffle.releaseProtocolFees - Loads stored `protocolTreasury` and dispatches `_transferQuote(treasury, amount)`.
packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:564-565 Raffle._transferQuote - Screens `treasury` via `_isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken))` and reverts with `InvalidQuoteDestination` if flagged.

packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:593-605 Raffle._isProtocolDestination - Compares `treasury` against `address(this)`, `factory`, `quoteToken`, `i_vrfV2PlusWrapper`, `prizeToken`, `canonicalFactory.raffleImplementation()`, and (when `treasury.code.length != 0`) `canonicalFactory.isRaffle(treasury)`.
packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:566 Raffle._transferQuote - Executes `quoteToken.safeTransfer(treasury, amount)` to transfer the six-decimal USDC fee claim to `protocolTreasury`.
packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:391 Raffle.releaseProtocolFees - Emits `ProtocolFeesReleased(msg.sender, treasury, amount)` and returns `amount`.

results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller context (msg.sender) invokes `releaseProtocolFees()` when `protocolFees == 0`; no caller-controlled parameters are accepted and execution halts at the zero-balance check.
results.flow_security_relevance: Enforces the precondition that protocol fees can only be released when a non-zero liability exists, preventing unallocated pot extraction before settlement and preventing duplicate fee payouts after `protocolFees` has been zeroed.
results.flow_summary: When `protocolFees == 0` (prior to winning ticket settlement, in `Refunding` status, when `PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS` rounds down to zero, or on a repeat call after fees were already released), `releaseProtocolFees()` reverts immediately with `NoProtocolFees()`.

results.flow_security_relevance: Zeroes the accumulated `protocolFees` liability and executes an external ERC-20 transfer of `quoteToken` to `protocolTreasury` after screening the recipient against protocol plumbing addresses; security review must verify strict CEI ordering, single-payout idempotency, accounting isolation from `unsettledPot`/`sponsorProceeds`/`winnerProceeds`/`remainingRefundLiability`, and that `protocolTreasury` cannot be a protocol sink.
results.flow_summary: When `protocolFees > 0` after winning ticket settlement (`NftWon` or `CashWon`), any external caller can invoke `releaseProtocolFees()` to zero `protocolFees`, validate `protocolTreasury` against protocol plumbing addresses via `_isProtocolDestination`, transfer the full accumulated `quoteToken` fee balance to `protocolTreasury`, emit `ProtocolFeesReleased`, and return the transferred amount.
results.flow_terminal_action: External ERC-20 token transfer `quoteToken.safeTransfer(protocolTreasury, amount)` followed by `ProtocolFeesReleased(msg.sender, treasury, amount)` event emission and return of `amount`.
